name: RiskCube
long_description:
RiskCube is building the first AI-native reinsurer for emerging risks.

Today, we operate an insurance brokerage focused on startups in AI, robotics, space, and defense. Through the brokerage, we see firsthand where traditional insurance products fail, from AI liability and autonomous systems to defense technology and new space risks.

We are now building proprietary risk models that can price risks even when little historical claims data exists. Our approach uses stochastic simulation, then applies traditional, explainable models to make the output transparent to underwriters and regulators.

This allows us to create new insurance and reinsurance products for emerging industries much faster than traditional carriers.

The U.S. insurance market still relies heavily on foreign reinsurance capacity.
Our goal is to build new reinsurance capacity on American soil for the industries defining the next generation of the U.S. economy, while reducing America's dependence on foreign reinsurance capacity.
one_liner: America’s first AI-native reinsurer for emerging risks.

launches.tagline: Top-rated insurance to close enterprise deals & gov contracts for AI, Space & Defense startups
launches.body:
Hey everyone[ 👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

I’m[ ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeilani)[Andrei](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrei-craciunescu/) - founder of[ ](https://www.brickwiseai.com/)[RiskCube](https://riskcube.com)

# **TL;DR**

**When startups sell to enterprise customers — especially regulated businesses — insurance is often required before the deal can close. Procurement teams ask for proof of top-rated insurance before they sign. Traditional  broker take weeks, which can slow down or kill the deal.**

# **RiskCube helps founders get covered fast, with proof of coverage ready within 24 hours.**

[RiskCube Introduction](https://youtu.be/eW4smKBySzo)

**Why This Problem Exists**

I built RiskCube after watching this happen repeatedly at WTW, one of the world's largest insurance brokers. When a startup tries to get top-rated insurance for something new — AI, data centers in space, defense tech, or space in general — most insurers either say no, take too long, or add exclusions.

Why?

* Little claims history for brand-new technology risks
* Insurers don't understand the product, so they exclude everything unfamiliar
* Big traditional insurance provider with expertise are built for big companies, not a startup closing its first Fortune 500 deal

The result: the wrong coverage, delayed deals, or lost deals entirely.

**How It Works**

1. **Tell us about your business** — a short form so we understand your company, customers, contracts, and risk profile.
2. **We search the market** — our AI reviews policies from 40+ rated insurers into a clear side-by-side comparison, and a licensed agent with deep risk expertise checks the coverage before you buy.
3. **Get your COI and close the deal** — choose your coverage, receive your Certificate of Insurance, and send proof to your customer or procurement team.

**Real Results**

One of our first YC customers cut insurance costs by 60%, got higher coverage limits than before, and became enterprise-ready in 4 hours.

**About the founder**

I'm Andrei, Founder & CEO. Previously in Risk & Analytics at WTW (Willis Towers Watson). Master in Mathematics from LMU Munich and PhD-level research in financial mathematics at TU Munich. Licensed insurance broker. Based in San Francisco.

Investors — want the same service for your portfolio companies? Reach out directly.
